prompt:
We've decided to retire docs/ingest.md. Move anything on it that belongs beside the code into the code, then delete the page.

Input files: README.md, docs/deploy.md, docs/ingest.md, ingest/__init__.py, ingest/rows.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/test_rows.py
assertions: No comment or docstring line was added to any Python file.
Every original comment and docstring in ingest/rows.py is kept word for word, and README.md and docs/deploy.md are unchanged.
No code changed: every Python file's code is the same apart from comments and docstrings.
No file was added to the repository.
The reply tells the user that the page only repeated what the code already says.
The reply gives a fate for each claim on the page: read_rows, is_blank, parse_price, clean and the csv-only note.
